static_traits.name: Liu Meijia
static_traits.educational_background: Has received formal music lessons since the age of 5
static_traits.family_status: Living alone; has a best friend in a band
static_traits.social_status: Relationship tension with the best friend in the band, withdrawn from the collaboration project; having some social support but finding it hard to reveal inadequacy to them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never had similar psychological problems before; never received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Able to clearly describe one's negative thoughts and experiences; good cooperativeness; speech rate and logic not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I feel depressed about my music career because my new songs have not been widely accepted, which makes me doubt my ability as a musician.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these inadequacies are affecting my passion and creativity for music, and I want to work through these negative thoughts.
growth_experiences: Systematically learning music and receiving formal training from age 5, music education running through the growth process, forming a music-centered career path and self-identity.

core_beliefs: I will never become an excellent musician
My worth depends on others' acceptance of my work

special_situations.event: Poor reception after new song release
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the work has not been widely accepted, it proves I am not good enough and will not succeed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks recognition and comfort from friends and fans (external validation)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never become an excellent musician

special_situations.event: When creating new music or performing, repeatedly recalls negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot achieve perfect performance or equal fame with peers, it equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stopping creation, avoiding performances or collaborations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will fail too; I cannot do it

special_situations.event: Continuously comparing oneself with successful musicians
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot reach their fame and level, I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compulsive comparison; seeks external validation even more
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never reach their level

special_situations.event: Seeing or thinking of lukewarm/negative feedback on a new song
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not like my songs, it means they think I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids revealing true feelings to others, reduces interaction

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and appreciated, becoming a valuable musician
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, fearing being unable to stand alongside peers and being belittled
defense_goal: Lowers the risk of being evaluated by avoiding creation and collaboration
Temporarily easing unease by seeking external recognition

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough musician who may be negated

manifestations: Doubting one's own musical ability and career prospects after poor reception of new songs
Uses others' fame and evaluations as the measure of self-worth, continuously comparing
Loses interest in home life, declining creative enthusiasm

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept in themselves to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language expressions include: 'He is looking down on me' and 'They want to exclude me'.
manifestations: When creating, repeatedly speculates how others will see oneself, presuming others hold negative views of oneself
Because of worrying about being evaluated, withdraws from a collaborative project with a close friend

positive_force: Has received systematic music training since age 5, with a solid professional foundation
Supportive relationship with a close friend in the band
Possessing self-awareness, able to identify and express negative automatic thoughts
Willing to seek psychological counseling and change (positive attitude)
negative_force: Cognitive biases are marked, such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mind reading
Over-relies on external recognition; self-worth fluctuates with others' feedback
Comparing with successful musicians leading to self-denial and despair
High expectations bringing increased stress; self-doubt affecting sleep and daily rhythms

target_behavior.behavior: During the creative process, avoids or stops writing due to negative evaluations
antecedent: Thinking of the last song's poor reception when starting a new one
Recalls or presumes others' negative views of his work
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic cognitions about career prospects and self-worth; excessive comparison leading to low self-efficacy
target_behavior.function: Escaping the anxiety of failure and being judged, temporarily lowering discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Declining creative efficiency and quality, hindered career development

target_behavior.behavior: Withdrawing from a collaboration project with a close friend
antecedent: Feeling not good enough, worrying about being compared or judged
Recalling the new songs' poor reception before and after collaborations
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and low self-esteem arising after seeking external recognition brought no relief, tending to avoid possible negative evaluations
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and potential conflict, maintaining short-term psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension, reduced social support, further weakening creative and performance drive

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly seeks external validation from friends and fans
antecedent: Low mood after poor reception of new songs
Feeling uncertain and unconfident before creating or performing
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth depending on external evaluation, trying to ease unease through affirmation
target_behavior.function: Gains comfort and confirmation for a brief confidence boost
target_behavior.consequence: Not yet able to effectively ease self-doubt, increasing dependence on others' evaluations
